enrichment_method.evidence: Per SILAC condition, 20 µl of pre-equilibrated GFP-Trap-A beads (Chromotek) were added to 2 mg of lysate and incubated 1h at 4°C rotating and followed by 3x washes with modified RIPA buffer.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The ten most intense ions were sequentially isolated and fragmented by HCD.
